query_normalized: systematic review of privacy-preserving federated learning protocols computer science
rationale: This paper belongs in the literature review because it provides critical empirical evidence on the security vulnerabilities of federated learning protocols, which is a fundamental prerequisite for evaluating and designing "privacy-preserving" systems (Category a: same-mechanism evidence regarding adversarial robustness in FL).
